newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish 10-yr bono spread over Bunds hits record low.
newsitem.headline: Spanish 10-yr bono spread over Bunds hits record low.

text.p: The spread between 10-year Spanish Bonos over German Bunds hit a record low of 151 basis points on Thursday amid continued enthusiasm for Spain's EMU chances and the outlook for interest rate cuts ahead, dealers said.
The previous low on the spread was set at 152 basis points on October 9, while the record high on December long term future contract was set yesterday at 109.93.
The market is eyeing the Spanish October CPI due later around 0900 GMT.
